苏元夜点雷部兵三龙横据水神厅（苏元夜点雷部兵三龙横据水神厅（第22页）“好久不执法了，手艺生疏，差点忘了这茬。”他抬起手，朝大门方向轻轻一招。两名力士应声出列，大步上前，一左一右，同时抬脚。“砰！”两扇大门应声而开。苏元迈步便往里走。还没进去，一股浓烈的烟气便扑面而来，呛得他连退了两步，会议室里蓝瓦瓦一片，连人影都看不清。“他妈的，这抽了多少烟这是。”崇应鸾抢上前一步，单手掐诀，一道清风从袖中鼓荡而出。那满室的烟雾被这阵风一卷，终于散去了些，露出了里头的真容。一张巨大的椭圆桌，乌泱泱坐满了人。主位上坐着三个须发皆白的魁梧老者，个个身形雄壮，不怒自威。左边那条老龙身披玄色锦袍，右边那条身着靛蓝长衫，正中那条则是一领月白大氅，三双龙目精光隐隐，光是坐在那里，便有一股无形的威压弥漫开来。左边那条老龙正端着一杆烟枪吞云吐雾，方才那满室的蓝烟，他至少贡献了一半。苏元看在眼里，心里冷笑一声。《天庭公共场所禁烟条例》第八十三条，集会场所严禁吸烟。这一条，先记上了。三位老者旁边，坐着水部部长鲁雄，此刻正满脸堆笑地给三位老龙斟茶。再往后是四海龙族的代表，一个个正襟危坐。再往后才是水部各司司长，林林总总不下三四十人。苏元的目光在屋子里扫了一圈，一直扫到椭圆桌的最角落的位置，才看见了余庆。大门被踹开的那一刻，所有人都扭过头来，几十道目光齐刷刷地落在苏元身上。会议室里响起一阵低低的议论声。鲁雄头一个反应过来，连忙站起身，朝主位那三条老龙拱了拱手，赔着笑道：“敖大人，敖大人，我给您介绍，这位是雷部新任……”苏元看着鲁雄这副诚惶诚恐的模样，心里暗暗摇了摇头。这部长都这副光景，下头的人是什么样，不用看也猜得到。坐在自己衙门里，对着几个挂职的老龙卑躬屈膝、战战兢兢，底下的人见了，谁还肯替你卖命？这衙门不烂才怪了。不过话说回来，鲁雄一介凡人，既无仙根，也无道骨，在天庭里头没根基、没背景、没人脉，能混个部长的位子安安稳稳坐到今天，也不容易。苏元倒也没心思为难他。“敖渊、敖霄、敖溟。”他一个一个地点出名来，“是谁？”三条老龙对视一眼，中间那条老龙捋了捋胡须，抬起头来，饶有兴致地打量着苏元，也没有开口的意思。苏元却也不等他们回话。“你们的事，发了。”话音未落，右边那条老龙猛地一拍桌子，霍然起身。他身量极高，站起来比苏元足足高了一个头，一龙须戟张，声如闷雷：“哪来的黄口小儿！你他妈……”苏元抬手就往脑后一抹，拔下三根头发，夹在指间，屈指一弹。三根白发离手，在空中迎风便涨，转瞬间化作三道匹练般的白虹，交错纵横，朝那老龙当头罩下。剑气过处，虚空寸寸碎裂。那老龙脸色骤变，急急往后一仰，屁股刚离了椅子便又重重坐了回去。剑光擦着他的头顶掠过，碎屑纷飞。苏元收回手，这才淡淡道：“谁让你站起来的。”

Chapter 664 Su Yuan ordered the thunder troops at night and three dragons occupied the water (page 1)
Su Yuanye ordered three dragons from the Lei Department to occupy the Water God Hall (Su Yuan Ye ordered three dragons from the Thunder Department to occupy the Water God Hall (page 22)) "I haven't enforced the law for a long time, and my skills are rusty. I almost forgot about this." He raised his hand and lightly moved toward the door. With a light move, the two warriors stepped forward, one to the left and the other to the right, and raised their feet at the same time. "Bang!" Su Yuan stepped forward and walked in, when a strong smoke hit his face. , choked, and he took two steps back. The conference room was so blue that no one could be seen clearly. "Damn it, how many cigarettes have you smoked?" Chong Yingluan took a step forward, kneading with one hand, and a breeze blew from his sleeves. The smoke in the room was blown away by the gust of wind, revealing the true appearance inside. There were three burly old men with white hair and beards sitting on the main seats. The old dragon on the left is wearing a black brocade robe, the one on the right is wearing an indigo gown, and the one in the middle is wearing a moon-white cloak. Three pairs of dragon eyes are faintly shining. Just sitting there, there is a sense of indifference. The pressure of the image spread. The old dragon on the left was puffing away from a pipe. He was responsible for at least half of the blue smoke that filled the room. He sneered in his heart when he saw it. Article 83 of the Smoking Regulations states that smoking is strictly prohibited in gathering places. Next to the three old men, Lu Xiong, the Minister of the Ministry of Water, was serving tea to three old dragons. Behind them were the representatives of the Four Seas Dragon Clan, sitting attentively. After that, there were no less than thirty or forty people in the Department of Water. Su Yuan glanced around the room until he saw the corner of the oval table. The moment the door was kicked open, everyone turned their heads, and dozens of eyes fell on Su Yuan. Lu Xiong was the first to react and stood up. He stood up, bowed his hands to the three old dragons on the throne, and said with an apologetic smile: "Master Ao, Master Ao, let me introduce to you, this is the new leader of the Lei Department..." Su Yuan looked at Lu Xiong's frightened look, and secretly shook his heart. He shook his head. With this minister in such a state, you can guess what the people below are like. Sitting in his yamen, groveling and trembling in front of a few temporary posts, who would be willing to see the people below. Working for you? It’s strange that the yamen is not bad. But then again, Lu Xiong is a mortal with neither immortal roots nor moral integrity. He has no foundation, no background, and no connections in the heaven, so he can sit quietly as a minister. Even today, it's not easy. Su Yuan didn't want to embarrass him. "Ao Yuan, Ao Xiao, Ao Ming." He asked one by one, "Who is it?" The three old dragons looked at each other, and the middle one stroked his beard. , raised his head and looked at Su Yuan with interest, without any intention of speaking. "Your matter is over." Before he finished speaking, the old dragon on the right slammed the table and stood up suddenly. He was extremely tall, standing a full head taller than Su Yuan. His beard spread out and his voice sounded like thunder: "Where did you come from, a kid with a yellow mouth! What the hell..." Su Yuan raised his hand and wiped the back of his head, pulled out three hairs, and clipped them With a flick of his finger, the three white hairs rose up in the air and turned into three streaks of white rainbows, criss-crossing the old dragon's head.His expression suddenly changed, and he leaned back hastily. As soon as his butt left the chair, he sat back down heavily. The sword light passed over his head, causing debris to fly. Su Yuan took back his hand and said calmly: "Who asked you to stand up."
